The YMCA would pay $4,266 per month, no more than $51,192 per year, from July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2025. The lease may be renewed once for five more years if both sides agree in writing.

vendor.name: Young Men's Christian Association (YMCA) of the East Bay

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: [Facilities] Use Agreement - Burbank Preschool and Diagnostic Center (Portion of) - YMCA of the East Bay - Early Childhood Education Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $99,100 for Care Solace to connect families and students with mental health providers
enrichment.summary: Care Solace would provide a web-based service that helps district staff, students and families find and connect with mental health treatment providers, including a "Warm Hand-off" process. The district would pay no more than $99,100 from July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023. A separate data-sharing agreement for the same period covers the information the district gives the vendor.

vendor.name: Addiction Treatment Technologies, LLC dba Care Solace

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Service Agreement and Data Sharing Agreement 2022-2023 – Addiction Treatment Technologies, LLC dba Care Solace - Office of the Chief of Staff
